chunks: Let him go out with us tomorrow that he may enjoy and play. We shall take care of him.
ai.seo_question: What did Jacob say to Joseph about his brothers taking him to Egypt?
ai.summary: In this verse, Prophet Jacob (Ya'qub) addresses his sons' request to take Joseph (Yusuf) to Egypt, granting permission with the assurance that they will guard him, reflecting the nuanced balance between parental trust and awareness of sibling rivalry. Shia scholars often highlight this moment as a test of faith for Jacob, who, despite knowing his sons' potential for deceit, exercises patience and divine wisdom in allowing the journey. The phrase 'we will be his guardians' underscores the temporary nature of their protection before the ultimate divine preservation of Joseph.
